# Parameters

`user_defined_params.py` in a case directory sets these by importing the
default `parameters` class and overriding whichever attributes that case
needs; `case.setup` reads the result and writes the FE input files EQdyna
runs from. The table below is generated directly from the defaults class, so
it cannot list a parameter that does not exist or show a stale default.

<!-- BEGIN PARAMETER REFERENCE (generated from scripts/defaultParameters.py by docs/user/gen_params.py; do not edit by hand) -->

Every entry below is an attribute of the `parameters` class in `scripts/defaultParameters.py`, read by `case.setup` and overridable per case in that case's own `user_defined_params.py`. Defaults shown are this class's own; a compset may set different values for its own physics.

  mode perform individual dynamic ruptures mode   = 2  # serve in earthquake cycles

* **`fymin`** -- default `0.0`

  for vertical strike-slip faults, we align faults along xz planes.

* **`fymax`** -- default `0.0`

  for vertical strike-slip faults, we align faults along xz planes.

* **`fzmin`** -- default `-22000.0`

* **`dx`** -- default `500.0`

* **`nuni_y_plus`** -- default `5`

## Material property

* **`rhow`** -- default `1000.0`

  fluid density

* **`nmat`** -- default `1`

  1: isotropic; >1: layered. nmat: number of layers

* **`n2mat`** -- default `3` (applies when nmat == 1)

  only Vp, Vs, rou, 3 (n2mat) are needed. Vp, Vs, Rou

* **`vp`** -- default `6000.0` (applies when nmat == 1)

* **`vs`** -- default `3464.0` (applies when nmat == 1)

* **`rou`** -- default `2670.0` (applies when nmat == 1)

* **`roumax`** -- default `rou` (applies when nmat == 1)

* **`vmaxPML`** -- default `vp` (applies when nmat == 1)

* **`n2mat`** -- default `4` (applies when nmat > 1)

* **`vp`** -- default `mat[nmat,1]` (applies when nmat > 1)

* **`roumax`** -- default `mat[nmat,3]` (applies when nmat > 1)

* **`vmaxPML`** -- default `vp` (applies when nmat > 1)

* **`init_norm`** -- default `-25000000.0`

  initial normal stress in Pa. Negative compressive.

* **`term`** -- default `5.0`

  total simulation time and dt

* **`dt`** -- default `0.5*dx/vp`

* **`rdampk`** -- default `0.1`

  Rayleigh damping coefficient; usually no need to change.

* **`C_elastic`** -- default `1`

  Controlling switches for EQquasi system elastic(1). parameters for viscoplastic rheology with C_elastic == 0:

* **`str1ToFaultAngle`** -- default `45.0`

* **`devStrToStrVertRatio`** -- default `0.33`

* **`gamar`** -- default `0.66`

  overpressurization coefficient

* **`bulk`** -- default `0.75`

  bulk friction

* **`coheplas`** -- default `5000000.0`

  Pa

* **`viscoplasticRelaxTime`** -- default `None`

* **`devStrTaperDepthStart`** -- default `None`

* **`devStrTaperDepthEnd`** -- default `None`

* **`plasticOutputHalfWidth`** -- default `(5000.0, 2000.0, 8000.0)`

* **`faultStNormalStressSign`** -- default `'extension'`

* **`C_nuclea`** -- default `1`

  artificial nucleation (1), no (0).

* **`C_degen`** -- default `0`

  degenerate hexahedrals (1), no (0).

* **`friclaw`** -- default `5`

  sw(1), tw(2), rsf_aging(3), rsf_slip_srw(4), rsf_slip_srw_tp(5).

* **`ntotft`** -- default `1`

  number of total faults.

* **`nucfault`** -- default `1`

  the fault id of nucleation fault. Should be no larger than ntotft

* **`insertFaultType`** -- default `0`

  0: planar fault, no interface inserted; 1: insert a customized (planar dipping) fault interface, generated by scripts/generateFaultInterface at case.setup time; 2: 1 + activate fractal fault (needs par.seedId); 3: rough fault whose surface is SUPPLIED by the case, not generated -- the case ships bFault_Rough_Geometry.txt, or hands case.setup a par.faultGeometryWriter that derives it from a shipped source (as test.tpv29 does with the official SCEC surface). The Fortran treats any value > 0 identically: read the file and morph the mesh onto it. Only the case.setup-time generator distinguishes 1/2 (generate) from 3 (use the case's own surface).

* **`seedId`** -- default `1`

* **`faultGeometrySourceDx`** -- default `None`

  Native node spacing (m) of the fault surface a compset SHIPS, when it ships one (insertFaultType 3).  A supplied surface is one fixed sampling of one random realisation: it can be coarsened exactly, never refined, so par.dx must be an integer multiple of this.  Declaring it here lets lib.requireFaultGeometryResolution give the same actionable verdict for every compset instead of each one's tooling failing its own way; leave it None when the geometry is generated (types 1/2) or absent (type 0). faultGeometrySourceName names the file in that message.

* **`faultGeometrySourceName`** -- default `'the fault-geometry source this compset ships'`

  Every spacing the compset can actually serve, for the rejection message.

* **`faultGeometrySourceAvailableDx`** -- default `None`

  A callable taking one argument, the output path, that (re)writes bFault_Rough_Geometry.txt for THIS case. case.setup calls it only when the file on disk is missing or does not match the case, so a correct file is never overwritten and case.setup is idempotent. Compsets set this instead of writing the geometry as an import side effect -- writing at import clobbers whatever the case author put there, which is how a correct hand-built 50 m TPV29 surface got silently replaced.

* **`faultGeometryWriter`** -- default `None`

* **`nt_out`** -- default `20`

  Every nt_out time steps, disp of the whole model and on-fault variables will be written out in netCDF format.

* **`tpv`** -- default `105`

  Control outputs

* **`output_plastic`** -- default `0`

* **`outputGroundMotion`** -- default `0`

  output big vel GM time series for all the surface stations?

* **`outputFinalSurfDisp`** -- default `0`

  output final surface displacement of all the surface stations?

## Nucleation

* **`nucR`** -- default `1500.0`

  nucleation patch radius, m

* **`nucRuptVel`** -- default `-9999.0`

  nucleation rupture velocity, m/s; useful for sw and tw.

* **`nucdtau0`** -- default `50000000.0`

  peak shear stress increase for TPV104 and 105, Pa; useful for rsf

* **`nucT`** -- default `1.0`

  Time (s) to nucleate to nucdtau0

* **`slipRateThres`** -- default `0.001`

  slip rate threshold (m/s) to record rupture time.

## HPC resource allocation

* **`casename`** -- default `str(tpv)`

* **`nx`** -- default `2`

* **`ny`** -- default `2`

* **`nz`** -- default `1`

* **`HPC_ncpu`** -- default `nx*ny*nz`

  Number of CPUs requested.

* **`HPC_nnode`** -- default `round(floor(HPC_ncpu/128)) + 1`

  Number of computing nodes. On LS6, one node has 128 CPUs.

* **`HPC_queue`** -- default `'normal'`

  q status. Depending on systems, job WALLTIME and Node requested.

* **`HPC_time`** -- default `'00:10:00'`

  WALLTIME, in hh:mm:ss format.

* **`HPC_account`** -- default `'EAR22013'`

  Project account to be charged SUs against.

* **`HPC_email`** -- default `''`

  "dliu@ig.utexas.edu" # Email to receive job status.

## Single station time series output

* **`st_coor_on_fault`**

  Default:

  ```
  [[0.0, -3.0], [0.0, -7.5], [0.0, -12.0], [9.0, -7.5], [12.0, -3.0], [12.0, -12.0], [15.0, -7.5], [18.0, -7.5], [-9.0, -7.5], [-12.0, -3.0], [-12.0, -12.0], [-15.0, -7.5], [-18.0, -7.5]]
  ```

  (x,z) coordinate pairs for on-fault stations (in km).

* **`st_coor_off_fault`** -- default `[[0, 9, 0], [0, -9, 0], [12, 6, 0], [12, -6, 0], [-12, 6, 0], [-12, -6, 0]]`

  (x,y,z) coordinates for off-fault stations (in km).

* **`n_on_fault`** -- default `len(st_coor_on_fault)`

* **`n_off_fault`** -- default `len(st_coor_off_fault)`
